Kaiṭabha
------------------------------------------
The Hindu पुराणस् contain interesting stories often aimed at glorifying a particular deity of the Hindu pantheon.
According to the Devībhāgavata (1.4.9) and the Devīmāhātmya (1) मधु and कैटभ were two demons who came out of the ears of Lord विष्णु when he was asleep. They tried to kill the four faced ब्रह्मा, the creator, who had just emerged from विष्णु’s nābhikamala or navel-lotus. ब्रह्मा then earnestly prayed to Mahākālī, an aspect of the Divine मोथेर्, who had put even विष्णु to sleep. As she came out of विष्णु’s body and manifested herself to ब्रह्मा, विष्णु woke up and fought with the two demons. Finding it difficult to subdue them, he had to pray to the Divine मोथेर् for help. With her power of delusion overcoming the demons, विष्णु succeeded easily in killing them.
See also DEVĪBHĀGAVATA and DEVĪ-MĀHĀTMYA.
